answer: I’ve seen this before: simulacra farms just balloon receipts, but here’s the twist. Each identity’s vote must pivot through a nebula of hashing walls, each step costing 0.1s on the delta schedule. The gale of peer-rechecks forces attackers to replay every receipt in full—no batching possible. Clones can’t cheat the wall time; the cost scales raw with heads, no EC2 magic.
